_note: Batch 8. Eight posts, 16 candidates read, 12 cards kept. Cut on the read: 3879's two capability lists were replaced by ONE card, because the post also carries a pharmacy-is-enough section the shortlist missed, which turns it into a real decision card instead of two lists of what an ER owns; 3879 'What an ER Can Do That a Pharmacy Cannot' was facility marketing. 3937's two lists were merged into one card because they are two tiers of the same decision, urgent care versus ER. 3979 gets one overview card of its eight emergencies rather than repeating the F.A.S.T. and heart-attack lists that 3886 and 3978 already carry. 4008's dehydration-signs list was dropped as a near-duplicate of the 3201 card; its heat exhaustion versus heat stroke split is its own distinctive content and follows the post's h3 structure.
